review.assessment: The diff changes the audit's baseline from `source_rows` to a derived count from `sink.pages`. Because paging already drops incomplete pages (the remainder), this new expected count matches the truncated output, causing the audit to pass silently despite missing source rows. The change fixes the test failure by lowering the standard rather than ensuring completeness or flagging the data loss.

findings.actual: Audit computes `expected=40` from the already-truncated pages, matches it against `written=40`, and exits with code 0 without raising an error. The export contains only 40 rows instead of all 47.
findings.defect: Masks data loss by basing the expected row count on already-truncated pages instead of source input, causing the audit to pass silently when incomplete pages are dropped by paging.
findings.expected: Audit should raise RowCountMismatch (or equivalent) when exported rows do not account for all 47 source rows, ensuring every row is present in the export.
